result.title: Exponential Wake-Up Overshoot in Explicit Gaussian Point-Process Filters
result.comment: 26 pages, 3 figures, 13 tables; main text with Appendices A-G (proofs, experimental protocol, additional results). A four-page version has been submitted to IEEE Signal Processing Letters
result.summary: When events resume after a long silence, explicit Gaussian point-process filters amplify the first update exponentially in the silence duration. We give the exact distribution of this update and a computable index that predicts when it overshoots. For the explicit (single-scoring-step) filter and its implicit posterior-mode counterpart, we derive second-order silence expansions of the state variance with opposite-sign logarithmic corrections. The crossing index determines when the post-wake prediction exceeds the resumed rate, separating the bin width at which the amplification exponent reaches one from the larger width at which the true rate is overshot. At fixed bin width, the implicit filter's expected loss grows logarithmically with silence duration, whereas a continuous-time counterexample rules out a bound uniform in bin width and silence duration. Experimental evaluation confirms these predictions in all 73 crossing cells and on exchange trade data, while variance caps reduce explicit overshoot but mostly hurt the implicit filter.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究显式高斯点过程滤波器在长时间无事件后首次更新被按沉寂时长指数放大的现象，给出该更新的精确分布、可计算的越界指数与状态方差的二阶展开，并在 73 个交叉单元和交易数据上验证预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 「沉寂时长放大单次状态更新」与越界指数，可能为 LVR 中证据稀疏或延迟到达时 latent 状态的更新强度与门控（何时 LOOK/STOP）提供类比与可核查的量化工具，但跨域迁移可行性尚需判断。
